# Guild Achieves

**Automatically congratulates your guildies on their achievements with hilarious, sarcastic messages!**

When a guild member earns an achievement, Guild Achieves waits 1-3 seconds (to seem human) and then sends a randomly selected funny congratulation to guild chat. With **950+ unique messages** across all achievement categories, your guild chat will never be boring again!

* * *

## Features

### 🎯 Smart Achievement Batching (NEW in v1.1.0!)

No more spam! The addon intelligently handles multiple achievements:

* **3-second collection window** \- Gathers all achievements before responding
* **Multi-achievement detection** \- When one player earns multiple achievements at once
* **Group achievement detection** \- When raid/dungeon groups earn the same achievement

...

### ⚙️ Fully Configurable

* **Enable/Disable** the entire addon with one click
* **Category Toggles** \- Turn off specific achievement types
* **Cooldown Control** \- Prevent spam when multiple achievements happen
* **Self-Congratulation** \- Option to congratulate yourself too!
* **Debug Mode** \- See what's happening under the hood

### 🗺️ Minimap Button

* **Left-click** to toggle on/off
* **Right-click** to open settings

* * *

## Slash Commands

* `/guildachieves` or `/ga` \- Open settings panel

* * *

## Installation

1. Download from CurseForge
2. Extract to `World of Warcraft/_classic_/Interface/AddOns/` (for MoP Classic)
3. Restart WoW or `/reload`
4. Check that "Guild Achieves" appears in your AddOns list

* * *

## Supported Versions

* ✅ **Mists of Pandaria Classic** (5.5.0)

# Guild management & recruitment platform

Finding and managing guilds has never been this easy!

[EXPLORE GUILDS](https://guildsofwow.com/looking-for-guild) [LIST RECRUITS](https://guildsofwow.com/recruits)

EXPLORE MORE

## CORE FEATURES

### Explore core functions to elevate your guild experience with Guilds of WoW

Integration Seamless integration with official Battle.net® & World of Warcraft® APIs. Team Management Take control of your guild's composition with targeted roster management and the flexibility to include non-guild members. Event Planning Plan and execute recurring events with precision using advanced filtration options and team management features. Discord Bot Automate event attendance tracking with the Discord bot, complemented by native Discord events support and a robust role engine.
In-Game Addon Enhance your in-game experience with Guilds of WoW's dedicated in-game add-on for event management, bidirectional RSVP integration, recruitment and more. Audits & Spreadsheets Experience roster auditing on the web, with additional support for Google Spreadsheets and APIs.

Continue with BATTLE.NET

## Streamlined RSVP Integration

### Direct integrations with Discord and In-Game Calendar

Guilds of WoW's Discord bot and in-game addon work together, allowing your RSVPs to sync seamlessly between Discord and the in-game calendar.

Integrations with Discord and In-Game Calendar

## Recruitment Simplified

### Display open spots, filter recruits and use customized application forms

RECEIVE Post class openings, receive applications and review players in one place for your guild and teams. REVIEW Gather your recruitment officers on GoW and Discord to vote, add notes and review applications.

results.title: Guild Roster Manager
excerpts: Detailed Guild Event Logging, Alt/Main Management, Member Bans, Additional Room for Member Notes, Mass Rank Management and Kick Tools, Inactivity Tracking, and much more. ... Designed by a Guild Leader, for Guild Leaders. Track joins, leaves, kicks, promotions, demotions, level ups, inactivity, note changes, birthdays, member anniversaries, and even name changes. Know exactly who did what and when. ... Identify alts and group them into an alt group with the ability to set 1 toon of the alt group as "Main." Mouseover any player in the roster to see their Main, their rank history, and all grouped alts.
